Docs/Embodiments

Embodiments

A shared task family supports multiple end-effectors; published scores use the canonical Sharpa setup.

Four supported end-effectors

01Parallel-jaw gripper

A gripper-based interface for cross-embodiment studies.

02Sharpa Hand

22 hand joints per side; the canonical Panda-based data and paper evaluation setup.

03Wuji Hand

A separate robot/retargeting profile with its own action space.

04XHand

An additional dexterous-hand interface with embodiment-specific configuration.

Supported is not scored

The paper’s six-method leaderboard uses Panda + Sharpa. Multi-hand code support does not imply a full scored suite for every hand. Report an alternative embodiment as a separate study and document any task or controller differences.

Sharpa controlAction layout
Single arm, 29-DArm 7 → hand 22
Bimanual, 58-DLeft arm 7 → right arm 7 → left hand 22 → right hand 22

Read other embodiments’ spaces from their registered agents. Do not pad or truncate to Sharpa dimensions without an explicit adapter. Match the selected robot UID, joint ordering, limits and calibration in both data collection and policy evaluation.
